body:
An agent working on a task should know when the tasks it depends on aren't finished. Unfinished means the same as on the board: not in a final column, with cancelled counting as finished.

- Where a task run is told about its task (the run prompt `board.rs` builds, and `session start --task` in `main.rs`), list the task's dependencies with their ids, titles and columns, and mark the unfinished ones.
- Add a short line to the brief: "This task depends on unfinished work. Check whether you can do your part without it. If you can't, ask the human (`task ask`) before building on code that doesn't exist yet." Keep it advice; nothing is refused.
- With no dependencies, or only finished ones, say nothing, so the brief stays short.
- Dependencies can be in another project; read them from the root.
- Tests: a brief with an unfinished dependency names it; a brief with none or only finished ones has no such line. Update Spec 15 or 03 where the brief's contents are described.
title: Agents: name a task's unfinished dependencies in its run brief
